VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 14, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Juanita Doplemore, Chair  Sylvia Contreras, Commissioner
Kenneth Osborn, Vice Chair  Mike Shaknovich, Commissioner
Ryan Antes, Commissioner  Josh Smith, Commissioner
Jesse Blanco, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Doplemore called the meeting to order at 5:10 p.m.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Antes, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith

Commissioners Absent: Blanco, Contreras, Shaknovich

Also present: Gina Overholt, Coordinator.

Also in attendance: Anita Lakhani, Deputy City Attorney, Christina Boatwright, Resource Connections
Division Officer and Nick Sramek, Veteran.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Meeting attendees recited the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52209  Recommendation to approve minutes for Veterans Affairs Commission meeting on
  January 10, 2024

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Doplemore, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  4  Antes, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Blanco, Contreras, Shaknovich

2.  24-52210  Recommendation to review Brown Act and Roberts Rules

  A motion was made by Commissioner Osborn, seconded by Commissioner

  Deputy City Attorney Anita Lakhani presented on the Brown Act and Roberts Rules.
  Discussion followed.

3.  24-52211  Recommendation to discuss Veterans banners pilot program

  Chair Smith presented the Veterans Banner subcommittee’s recommendations for
  the banner design, banner vendor and nomination form content. A motion to select
  the American flag-centered design was made by Ryan and seconded by Ken.
  Smitty made a motion to approve A3 as the banner vendor, which Ryan seconded.
  A motion was made by Smitty and seconded by Ryan to approve the content of the
  nomination form.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Osborn, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  4  Antes, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Blanco, Contreras, Shaknovich

4.  24-52212  Recommendation to discuss 2024 Meeting Calendar

  Chair Doplemore presented the 2024 calendar of meetings and events. On March
  13, the Los Angeles County Department of Military Veterans Affairs (MVA), in
  partnership with District 4 Supervisor Janice Hahn’s office, will hold its Veteran
  Town Hall here in Long Beach (at the American Gold Star Manor). Discussion: the
  Commission will attend this event and move its March meeting to a different date
  and ultimately selected Tuesday, March 26 as the new meeting date.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Doplemore, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  4 Antes, Doplemore, Osborn, Smith

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Staff shared information about four events, including the 2/23 Veteran’s Resource Fair at the
Battleship Iowa, 2/24 Veteran Stand Down in Garden Grove, 3/13 Veteran Town Hall in Long Beach,
3/16 Nixon Library Veteran Appreciation Day.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Doplemore adjourned the meeting at 6:35 p.m.
